episodes.title: Welcome to the Undervale
episodes.summary: Desperate to attract paying customers, Katherine hires an exorcist to get rid of the hotel's ghosts. Ben finds an unexpected soul mate.

episodes.title: Unfinished Business
episodes.summary: Katherine is concerned that a rebellious ghost is a bad influence on Esther. A power outage sends Nathan, Ben and Abaddon into the woods.

episodes.title: Randy Slasher
episodes.summary: While Katherine summons the courage to go out on a date, the rest of the crew deals with a creepy killer who targets lusty teens.

episodes.title: How to Train Your Demon
episodes.summary: Abaddon struggles to control his instincts, Katherine bumps into a business rival, and Nathan, Ben and Esther investigate a possible werewolf.

episodes.title: Rollyfluffs
episodes.summary: Esther's plan to become more popular backfires when she starts a dangerous new trend at school. The hotel's honeymoon suite turns on the charm.

episodes.title: Ghost Hunters!
episodes.summary: A ghost-hunting reality show films an episode at the Undervale. Ben opens up to an enchanted diary and shares all his relationship drama.

episodes.title: Seven Deadly Bens
episodes.summary: Ben's desire to be more confident spawns multiple personalities. Meanwhile, Nathan keeps falling through floors... but why?

episodes.title: Aunt Rose
episodes.summary: A curmudgeonly relative comes to visit — with no plans to leave. Abaddon is outsmarted by a doorstop, and Esther experiments with raising the dead.

episodes.title: The Esthercist
episodes.summary: Esther takes charge when soul-sucking demons invade the hotel. Katherine shares a painful truth with Nathan about his death.

episodes.title: The Acolytes of Abaddon
episodes.summary: The good news? There's a busload of red-cloaked customers who want to stay at the Undervale. The bad news? They might be part of a world-ending cult.
